summary: Re-reviewed earlier: MC std / Cramer-Rao ratio 0.875-1.106 for the 3 identifiable cells, systematic pattern as stated, scope correctly limited to self-consistency (shared model/table), not physical fidelity. No overclaim.

Reviewed earlier: statistic correctly scoped as iodine line integral g/cm2 on 27 rays, 2-material estimator on 3-material phantom; 1e6/1e5 bias ratios M2 0.89, M4 1.02 consistent with dose-independence; framed as implementation confirmation, not discovery.

Re-ran verify2.py on real 48 P2 rays, noise-free MLE, all converged. M2 signed-mean z: iodine tilt +10% = +4.6, -10% = -5.2 (rms/floor 0.82/0.92); iodine escale +-2% z -22.3/+23.1 (rms/floor 3.79/3.94); WATER tilt z -23.6/+25.1 (rms/floor 3.99/4.26). Matches claims. Not over-corrected: iodine tilt bias is only 0.66-0.75 floor per ray and z~5 arises only by pooling 48 rays; z assumes a pure-noise null (20 draws/ray, no other bias source) and is a noise-free hypothetical power, not an observed statistic. Suggested wording changes: (a) say iodine-tilt case is marginal (z~5 only via pooling, not per-ray); (b) my M4 P2 recompute with the same rms/floor definition gives 27-43x (signed z 186-294), not 21-38x; conclusion unaffected but correct the range or state its definition.

Re-ran: full-rank fraction at rtol 1e-2 = 0% (M2 k=2), 58.33% (M4 k=2 P2), 0% (M4 k=3 P3); 100% for 1e-3..1e-10. sv_min/max 0.0020-0.0066 (M2), 0.0048-0.0123 (M4 k2), 0.0022-0.0094 (M4 k3), consistent with 0.0020-0.0123. Median iodine CRLB k=2 P2 1e6: M4 0.00151, M2 0.00376 (ratio 2.49x), exact. Not overstated: labelled idealised upper bound (no detector response/charge sharing/pile-up); structural vs empirical separation correct. Not re-run by me: condition numbers (195/99/217) and the 2.4x rms figure.

RECOMPUTED from model_data npy: mu matrix, col angle 1.043deg, SVs 3.697/1.176/0.0029, cond 1272.9 all reproduce. BUT it is the zero-thickness (spectrum-mean) matrix. Beam-hardened local effective mu (-dlnT/dP) at 10cm: cond 912-964, angle 0.94-0.97deg; at 25cm: cond ~754-796, 0.87-0.91deg; calcification column drops 25-40%. So cond=1273 is an upper bound; 750-1270 realistic; order of magnitude survives. MORE SERIOUS: 'exact recovery in noiseless challenge data is possible' is FALSE in image domain. Downloaded the real kit (md5 7aaf6b55 OK): real lowkVp/highkVp images deviate from linear model A@x by ~0.026/0.016 per cm (~10%) on tissue; repo's sum_to_one inversion on real kit cases 0-2 gives RMSE 1.56 vs zero-prediction 0.446; tissue-only RMSE 1.70-1.78 vs 0.567. A 5-10% mu mismatch is amplified (sigma_max(B^-1[:,:2])=343) into garbage. Fix: scope claim to exact-linear synthetic; state mismatch result.

Downloaded real kit and checked ALL 10 cases. Case-0 numbers reproduce under strict defs (exact0 35.14%, |s-1|<=4e-8 59.5%, strictly between 5.35%). Split is IDENTICAL in all 10 cases (support mask identical; allclose sums) so no variation - but this means 10 samples are one geometry, not independent evidence. Threshold-dependent: at |s-1|<=1e-3 it is 36.3/60.4/3.4. No fourth class: true (sum<=1.0000, never >1.001, no negatives). ERROR: text says maxima 'calcification 0.566 (10-case sample)' - 0.566 is case 0 only; 10-case max is 0.738 (per-case 0.566-0.738). Band deficit median 0.58, 10% quantile 0.006: band is heterogeneous.

Synthetic only (labelled). Recomputed sigma_max(B^-1[:,:2])=343.4; 343.4*|b|(0.3724)/|x|(0.7071)=180.9 matches 181. Comparing 181 to cond=1273 (0.14x) is apples to oranges but harmless. Caution: inherits F-012 exact-linear-model assumption; on real images mismatch dominates (see F-012).

Band fraction '~5%' is case-0 strict-threshold (5.35%); 3.4% at 1e-3 tol (all 10 cases). Claim that band error >> deficit is synthetic-only and not labelled so; on real kit images the TISSUE pixels fail (tissue RMSE 1.7 sum_to_one) because of model mismatch, so 'boundary pixels are the hard case' does not transfer. AIR_CUTOFF caveat honestly stated.

Numbers match metrics.json: s1 sum_to_one 1.1788, zero_prediction 0.4301, simplex 0.0508, boundary_rmse 3.838; unconstrained 0.3027. Synthetic caveat stated. But band is 1650/17408=9.5% of synthetic pixels vs 3.4-5.4% real. REAL-DATA CHECK (kit cases 0-2, repo code, RMSE): zero 0.446, unconstrained 0.317, sum_to_one 1.555, simplex 0.379. So sum_to_one worse than nothing holds on real data, but simplex does NOT clearly beat zero (0.379 vs 0.446, worse than unconstrained) and cause is model mismatch not the band. 'Regime-separated reporting mandatory' fine; the 'simplex wins' ordering is a synthetic-generator artifact.

Overclaim: 'whole-tree git_dirty flag is ALWAYS true' - RUN-0006 record shows git dirty=False (RUN-0003 True). Process claim; could not replay runmeta. Reword to 'was true in RUN-0003/4/5 because outputs were tracked'.

Recomputed with real polychromatic model: truth [8,4,.05] -> decoy [12.7219,-0.5106,0.1], lnT residual 1.3e-15, ||dx||=6.53 reproduces. But that decoy has negative fibroglandular, unreachable for any constrained method. Searched nonneg decoys (grid of truths, total<=16 cm): largest FULLY NONNEGATIVE ||dx||=19.7 cm (truth [1,14,0.2] -> [15.27,0.37,0.35], resid<1e-10), so claim is STRENGTHENED, the negative example is just poorly chosen. Caveats: per-ray result; map-level exactness unproven (null direction rotates 0.02-0.05deg with path, so pixelwise-constant shift leaves lnT residual ~1e-4 or worse); 'network converges to whichever prior prefers' is extrapolation.

(a) 'Larger decoys do go negative, so nonnegativity bounds the family' is wrong: fully nonnegative exact decoys exist with ||dx||=19.7 cm (truth [1,14,0.2]->[15.27,0.37,0.35]) vs the 0.26 band example. Band decoy [0.735,0.073,0.006] reproduced (resid 2.5e-16, sum 0.814). (b) sum-to-one removing pixelwise ambiguity holds only in the linear exact model, but real images are ~10% off linear (F-012) so paper identifiability does not give recoverability. (c) real fractions 36.3/60.4/3.4% (1e-3) vs claimed 35/60/5.

Fetched arXiv 2604.25356 PDF: 'soft tissue and calcification were chosen as basis materials'; 'two input and output channels'; MBIR with lambda=0 unregularized; loss is MSE of LE/HE projections (Eq.5/6); text says median while Table 1 caption says Mean RMSE (inconsistency flagged by lead). 2-from-2 confirmed. Not rechecked: 5.83 vs 13.07, Sec 4.2 inverse-crime wording.

Fetched arXiv 2311.10641: discriminator learns from 'reference low-noise material-specific images' generated 'from SECT using threshold and normalization', 'do not have to be associated with the input DECT'; reference not ground truth but same threshold method used for eval GT. Confirms unpaired-reference, not label-free. Not checked: lambda, SD -91-97%, square 2x2 ROI-derived A.
